key_insight: PathKGen combines visual features with structured pathology knowledge to generate histopathology reports and expose its knowledge-based reasoning as graphs.
clinical_relevance: The approach could support more interpretable automated pathology reporting, but the abstract does not establish clinical readiness.
method: A visual branch uses pathology foundation models to produce visual tokens.
A knowledge branch queries a pathology-specific knowledge graph for key morphological features and produces knowledge tokens.
A multimodal large language model uses both token streams to generate reports.
evidence_signal: On WSI-Bench, the authors report outperforming previous state-of-the-art methods, though the abstract provides no numerical results.
watch_item: Visible reasoning graphs do not guarantee correct reports; performance may depend on the knowledge graph’s accuracy and coverage.
paper_title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
